messages:
elaine.s: Heads-up — escalated from Support: customer reported intermittent 500s + missing audit events for 2025-06-15 03:12–03:20 UTC. Auditor also asked for SOC 2 evidence for that window. Ticket #CS-4287.

sam.oncall: I pulled the ingestion metrics. There are Kinesis write throttles at 03:13:08 and a downstream S3 PutErrors burst. Looks like backpressure.

platform-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-0615-01 (linked to CS-4287).

tess.infra: Quick note — our logging pipeline (kinesis -> lambda-normalizer -> s3) will drop events when lambda concurrency hits the account limit. We had a concurrent Lambda surge from a billing spike at ~03:12.

maria.sec: Auditor asked for a) a signed manifest of delivered audit logs for that window, b) retention proof that nothing was deleted beyond policy, and c) a timeline of any ingestion failures and remediation.

elaine.s: Can we produce an export that shows exactly which events are missing and why? Auditor wants repro steps and chain-of-custody to include checksums.

sam.oncall: We can reconstruct delivered objects. S3 prefixes: s3://rwinf-logs/prod/yyyy=2025/mm=06/dd=15/hour=03/. I see 03:00–03:11 has full objects, 03:12–03:20 shows partial files and several 0-byte multipart objects.

sam.oncall: Repro steps for the infra team: 1) run a 1k req/s burst to the public inference endpoint for 60s with header X-Debug-Audit: true; 2) watch lambda concurrency and Kinesis PutRecordThrottles; 3) observe s3 put failures when concurrency above 800. Example load generator:
```bash
hey -n 60000 -c 1000 -H "X-Debug-Audit: true" https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate
```

tess.infra: Confirmed. Test lambda concurrency config currently set to 1000; account concurrency at the time was 950 used by other jobs. Combined spike hit 1960 -> exceeding sum reserved. That caused the normalizer to retry and some multipart uploads ended up aborted.

maria.sec: For the SOC 2 packet we need: - SHA256 of each S3 object in that hour; - CloudTrail events that show object puts/deletes; - Kinesis CloudWatch metrics + Lambda logs with throttling traces; - a signed statement from infra on what caused deletion/zero-byte objects.

elaine.s: Auditor also wants to know whether any customer data was retained longer than policy during remediation (they're worried about partial uploads).

sam.oncall: We didn't perform any ad-hoc deletes. The aborted multipart parts were garbage-collected by lifecycle after 7 days per our policy. We can show the lifecycle rules and the multipart-list call results for that prefix.

maria.sec: I'll draft the evidence checklist. Who can create a reproducible export (tarball) with: object list + per-object SHA256 + CloudTrail slice + Lambda logs slice + Kinesis metric CSV? Auditor prefers a single signed archive and a verification script.

tess.infra: I can run an export job: export tool supports --prefix and --since/--until. Command: 
```bash
./tools/export-logs --prefix "prod/yyyy=2025/mm=06/dd=15/hour=03/" --since "2025-06-15T03:00:00Z" --until "2025-06-15T03:30:00Z" --include-cloudtrail --output /tmp/CS-4287-export.tar.gz
```

platform-bot: Export job started (job-id: export-20250615-3312).

sam.oncall: Note: for auditor chain-of-custody we should sign the tar with our KMS key (alias/rwinf-evidence-key) and include a KMS key rotation history snippet. Auditor asked specifically whether key rotation overlapped the window. It did not — last rotation 2025-05-01.

maria.sec: I'll prepare the signed manifest template. Include: filenames, sha256sum, signer, KMS-encrypted signature, generation timestamp, and the verification script.

elaine.s: ETA to produce archive and packet? Need to tell the auditor timeline.

tess.infra: Export job ETA ~15m. After export completes I'll run sha256sum and sign with KMS. Expect final artifact in /secure-evidence/CS-4287/ by 03:40Z.

sam.oncall: Also preparing a short reproducible runbook that shows how the spike leads to throttles + aborted multipart uploads. Will include the hey command and lambda concurrency table.

maria.sec: Once I have the artifact I'll attach to the SOC2 evidence portal and ping the auditor. Will also include the remediation notes and the lifecycle policy reference.

auditor_system: ACK received. Please include a short explanation of why aborted multipart uploads result in 0-byte footprints in S3 listings and how lifecycle handles them.

elaine.s: Thanks everyone. I'll update the CS ticket and confirm to the customer that we're providing the full SOC2 evidence packet and a remediation plan.

platform-bot: Export job completed: export-20250615-3312. Artifact: /secure-evidence/CS-4287/rwinf_export_2025-06-15_03-00_03-30.tar.gz (signed with alias/rwinf-evidence-key).

maria.sec: Artifact verified, manifest attached and signed. Uploading to evidence portal now.

elaine.s: Noted — I'll send the auditor the portal link and the expected delivery time. Closing loop on CS-4287 when auditor confirms receipt. :white_check_mark:
